approaches.title: Dense seat-grid simulation
approaches.summary: Allocates a full seat-availability grid for every cinema row, marks reserved seats, and counts non-overlapping four-seat family blocks row by row. This revision is marked wrong due to out-of-memory behavior for large n.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds an n-by-10 boolean seat grid and evaluates each row’s possible family blocks. Marked wrong for OOM, with debug output also present.

approaches.title: Sparse sorted reserved-row processing
approaches.summary: Sorts reservations by row, processes only rows containing reserved seats, and adds two families for each untouched row. It retains the same block-availability checks while avoiding allocation proportional to n.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the full seat grid with sorted reservation chunks and a temporary ten-seat row model, then accounts for unreserved rows with n * 2. Removes debug output and is marked correct.
